message.content:
Of course! Here's a review written from the perspective of a genuine, frustrated customer.

***

**(Star Rating: 1/5 – "Avoid if you can")**

**Service: Absolute Nightmare – Zero Follow-Up, Total Disregard**

I booked this service three months ago based on their slick website and promises of "white-glove care" and "constant communication." What I actually got was the exact opposite.

After the initial consultation (which was fine), they completely ghosted me. The project started a week late with no explanation. Emails went unanswered for days. When I finally got a reply, it was a generic, one-line "We're looking into it." The person assigned to my project seemed to have vanished; calls went straight to voicemail.

The few times work *was* done, it was shoddy and half-finished. I had to point out basic mistakes from their own plan. It felt like I was managing *them*, not the other way around. I’ve never paid so much to be so stressed and ignored.

The final straw was when they missed a critical deadline, costing me real money on my end. Their response? A terse email blaming "supply chain issues" that were never mentioned before. No apology, no offer to compensate for the fallout.

I’m not usually one to write angry reviews, but this was genuinely one of the worst professional experiences I've ever had. They took my money and then treated me and my project with total disregard. Save yourself the headache and look elsewhere.

**Posted by: Mark T., verified customer on June 15, 2024**
